items.exampleEn: My sister always puts off her homework until Sunday night.
items.exampleZh: 我妹妹總是把功課拖到星期天晚上才寫。

items.exampleEn: I can't put up with the noise from upstairs anymore.
items.exampleZh: 我再也受不了樓上傳來的噪音了。

items.exampleEn: We ran out of milk, so I went to the store.
items.exampleZh: 我們的牛奶喝完了，所以我去了商店。

items.exampleEn: Can you help me set up my new computer?
items.exampleZh: 你可以幫我把新電腦裝好嗎？

items.exampleEn: The runners set off at exactly eight o'clock.
Which of your parents do you take after?
items.exampleZh: 你像你爸媽中的哪一位？

items.exampleEn: The test turned out to be easier than I thought.
items.exampleZh: 考試結果比我想的還簡單。

items.sentenceEn: The smoke from the kitchen set the alarm off.
items.sentenceZh: 廚房冒出的煙讓警報器響了。

items.audioEn: We ran out of time, so we couldn't answer the last question.
items.audioZh: 我們時間不夠用，所以最後一題沒能作答。
items.questionZh: 他們為什麼沒有回答最後一題？

items.sentenceEn: His trip to work is long, but he puts up with it.
items.sentenceZh: 他上班的路程很遠，但他都忍下來了。

items.sentenceEn: We drove to the shop, but it turned out that it was closed.
items.sentenceZh: 我們開車去那家店，結果發現它沒開。

items.stemEn: Everyone says the baby ____ her father. She has his big eyes.
items.stemZh: 大家都說這個寶寶長得像她爸爸，她有一雙跟他一樣的大眼睛。

items.stemEn: The company ____ a new office in Taichung last year.
items.stemZh: 這家公司去年在台中成立了新的辦公室。

items.passageEn: Last summer, my family planned a camping trip, but we had to put it off for a week because of the rain. Finally, we set off early one Saturday morning. When we got to the lake, Dad and I set the tent up while Mom made lunch. That night, we ran out of water, so Dad had to drive to a shop. We also had to put up with lots of mosquitoes. Nevertheless, the trip turned out to be one of our best ever.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我們家計畫去露營，但因為下雨，只好延後一個星期。最後，我們在某個星期六一大早出發。到了湖邊，我和爸爸把帳篷搭起來，媽媽則做午餐。那天晚上，我們的水用完了，爸爸只好開車去商店買。我們還得忍受很多蚊子。儘管如此，這趟旅行結果是我們最棒的一次。

questions.questionZh: 他們為什麼把露營延後？
那天晚上，他們什麼東西用完了？

items.promptZh: 我們明天一早就要出發去台中。
referenceEn: We will set off for Taichung early tomorrow morning.
We are setting off for Taichung early tomorrow morning.
Early tomorrow morning, we are going to set off for Taichung.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 set off、set off for Taichung 等
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 leave for Taichung、start out for Taichung 等）也算對
用表示未來的寫法（例如 will、be going to、are setting off 等）
「明天一早」可寫，例如 early tomorrow morning、tomorrow morning 等，放句首或句尾都可以

items.promptZh: 這場會議延到下星期了。
referenceEn: The meeting has been put off until next week.
The meeting was put off until next week.
They put off the meeting until next week.
They put the meeting off until next week.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，受詞可放中間或後面（例如 put off the meeting、put the meeting off 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 was postponed、was moved to next week 等）也算對
可用被動式（例如 was put off、has been put off 等），也可用 they 當主詞
時態可用，例如過去式、現在完成式（was put off、has been put off 等）
